hero.title: Computational Multiphysics Research Group
hero.description: Bridging atoms to continuum — we simulate every scale, material, and interface across defense, aerospace, energy, and bioinspired systems.

updates.title: Lumina Presented at HEMCE 2026!
updates.text: Our team delivered a talk on 'Lumina: An AI-Augmented Multiscale Material Informatics Framework', showcasing offline AI data querying and HPC-ready material models for extreme engineering regimes.

updates.title: CoMPhys at INCAM 2026!
updates.text: Presenting three papers at the 7th Indian Conference on Applied Mechanics — adaptive implicit modeling (PyAMorph), stochastic microstructure transport (PuMA), and ConvLSTM stress prediction.

updates.title: Hosting the AeSI CFD Symposium 2026
updates.text: As organizers of the Aeronautical Society of India's Annual CFD Symposium at IIT Madras, we invite you to submit your abstracts before the deadline.

updates.title: Co-organizing ICNMMF-6 at IIT Madras
updates.text: The 6th International Conference on Numerical Methods in Multiphase Flows — January 18-20, 2027, at IIT Madras. Join global experts in Chennai.

research.heading: Research Areas
research.description: A multidisciplinary approach spanning computational physics and engineering — from nature's flyers to hypersonic reentry.

items.title: Bioinspired Flows
items.text: Modeling unsteady aerodynamics in nature's flyers and biological systems.

items.title: Energetic Material Dynamics
items.text: Simulating shock, reaction, and detonation in high-energy materials.

items.title: Hypersonic Reentry Physics
items.text: Capturing extreme aerothermal loads, ablation, and gas-surface interactions.

items.title: High Strain-Rate Response
items.text: Material deformation and failure under extreme dynamic loading.

items.title: AI-Driven Multi-Scale Modeling
items.text: Accelerating simulations with machine learning across scales and physics domains.

join.heading: Join Our Research Community
join.description: We welcome curious minds eager to learn, code, model, and make a difference in science, engineering, and real-world applications.
